verdict.rationale: A cloud database service like ClickHouse Cloud could plausibly publish a no-training policy or an AI-training opt-out, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data policies, opt-out controls, or data-use commitments for AI models. The ability to self-host or run ClickHouse locally is a related deployment option, not a documented control that prevents training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
